coupons_discount_check.name: coupons_discount_check
coupons_discount_check.value:
("coupons"."discount_type" = 'percent' and "coupons"."percent_off" between 1 and 100 and "coupons"."amount_off" is null)
        or ("coupons"."discount_type" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."amount_off" > 0 and "coupons"."currency" in ('INR', 'USD') and "coupons"."percent_off" is null)

product_files_delivery_check.name: product_files_delivery_check
product_files_delivery_check.value:
("product_files"."delivery_type" = 'file' and "product_files"."file_key" is not null and "product_files"."external_url" is null)
        or ("product_files"."delivery_type" = 'external_link' and "product_files"."external_url" is not null and "product_files"."file_key" is null)
        or ("product_files"."delivery_type" = 'lesson_resource' and ("product_files"."file_key" is not null or "product_files"."external_url" is not null))

products_price_check.name: products_price_check
products_price_check.value:
("products"."is_free" and "products"."price_inr" is null and "products"."price_usd" is null)
        or (not "products"."is_free" and ("products"."price_inr" is null or "products"."price_inr" > 0)
            and ("products"."price_usd" is null or "products"."price_usd" > 0))
